_meta.goal: Money flow to each district over time + who is responsible + how the system functions/dysfunctions. Pilot district: Kolkata.
_meta.rules: PDF-cited or it's a gap. Every fact carries source + source_tier. Gaps recorded in _gaps, never guessed. Footnotes in UI point to the public record.
_meta.footnotes_render: source_tier 4 (news) and 3 (wikipedia) are shown but visibly flagged as needing upgrade to a government PDF source.

coverage.note: 594 districts across 35 states/UTs. 3 hand-authored deep exemplars (Kolkata, Birbhum, Jamshedpur); the rest are honest baseline skeletons (admin-model classified, empty roster/ledger with explicit _gaps — not fabricated).

_meta.managing_agency_note: Until April 1970, the colonial 'managing agency' system let a few partners control ~3/4 of Indian industry via tiny shareholdings. The Indira Gandhi govt abolished it; post-1947 heavy industry shifted to central PSUs.

protocol_layers._doc: Four stacked protocols that govern how money and authority move between the Union, the State, and the District/local body. Read top-to-bottom: WHO MAY (constitutional) -> HOW MONEY MOVES (fiscal) -> WHO ANSWERS (administrative) -> WHAT GATES IT (sanction).

layer_1_constitutional.name: Constitutional authority — Seventh Schedule
layer_1_constitutional.decides: Who legally MAY legislate/control a subject (and therefore its money).

lists.union: Union List (List I) — 97 entries. Only Parliament. Defence, foreign affairs, banking, inter-state rivers, income tax, customs.
lists.state: State List (List II) — 66 entries. Only State Legislature. Police, public health, agriculture, land, local govt.
lists.concurrent: Concurrent List (List III) — 47 entries. Both; Union law prevails on conflict (Art. 254). Education, social security, forests, economic & social planning.
lists.local_body: Eleventh & Twelfth Schedules (73rd/74th Amendments, 1992) — 29 PRI + 18 ULB functions constitutionally devolved to panchayats & municipalities.

layer_2_fiscal.name: Fiscal transfer chain — how money flows down
layer_2_fiscal.decides: The route a rupee travels from the Union to a village.

channels.fc_devolution: Finance Commission (Art. 280) — States' share of the divisible pool of central taxes. UNTIED. 41% per 15th FC. The constitutional, formula-based channel.
channels.css: Centrally Sponsored Schemes — Union-designed, cost-shared (e.g. 60:40), TIED to scheme rules. Routed Union ministry -> State Nodal Account -> implementing tier via PFMS.
channels.central_sector: Central-sector schemes — 100% Union-funded, Union-implemented (e.g. MPLADS). Bypass State share.
channels.art_275_grants: Grants-in-aid (Art. 275) — specific-purpose grants from Union to States on FC recommendation.
channels.state_own: State's own taxes (SGST, stamp duty, excise, land revenue) + State schemes -> own treasury -> district.
channels.local_own: Local-body own-source revenue (property tax, user fees) — the bottom, usually thinnest, layer.

layer_2_fiscal.instruments: PFMS (Public Financial Management System) is the rail; Consolidated Fund of India (Art. 266) -> Consolidated Fund of the State -> agency accounts.

layer_3_administrative.name: Administrative command chain — who answers
layer_3_administrative.decides: Which post is accountable, and whether it is Union-cadre, State-cadre, or elected.
layer_3_administrative.spine: Union: President -> Governor (Union's man in the State). State: CM/Council -> Chief Secretary -> District Magistrate/Collector (IAS, All-India Service) -> SDO -> BDO. Police: DGP -> SP/CP (IPS) -> SHO. Local: elected Mayor/Pradhan + appointed Commissioner/CEO. Judiciary: HC -> District Judge (separate).
layer_3_administrative.key_tension: The DM/Collector and SP are recruited by the Union (All-India Services, Art. 312) but serve the State — 'dual control' is the structural fault line of Indian federalism.

layer_4_sanction.name: Sanction & accountability protocol — what gates the spend
layer_4_sanction.decides: The procedural checkpoints money must clear, and where it can stall or leak.
gates: Fund release via PFMS (often instalment-based, conditional on prior utilisation)
Utilisation Certificate (UC) — must account for prior tranche before the next
Social Audit (mandatory for MGNREGS, Sec 17 NREGA)
CAG audit (Art. 148–151) -> report tabled in legislature -> PAC scrutiny
layer_4_sanction.failure_modes: Where the protocol breaks: unspent funds lapsing, low utilisation %, fund FREEZE upstream (e.g. NREGA Sec 27), pending UCs blocking next release, CAG paras / audit flags, vendor irregularities.

MGNREGS.full_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
MGNREGS.const_basis: Economic & social planning (Concurrent List Entry 20); enacted as NREGA 2005, a Union law on a Concurrent subject.
MGNREGS.implementing_tier: Gram Panchayat / Block (PO), district nodal = DC/DM
MGNREGS.fiscal_route: Union MoRD -> NEFMS / Central NREGA fund -> direct DBT to worker accounts; admin/material via State -> District -> Block -> GP
MGNREGS.sanction_protocol: Labour budget approved -> fund release on UC + pending-liability -> geo-tagged assets -> Social Audit (mandatory, Sec 17) -> CAG

PMAY-G.const_basis: Housing is a State subject; delivered as a CSS via the cooperative-federal route.
PMAY-G.implementing_tier: Gram Panchayat / Block, district nodal = DC/DM (DRDA/ZP)
PMAY-G.fiscal_route: Union MoRD -> State Nodal Account (PFMS) -> DBT instalments to beneficiary on geo-tagged construction stage
PMAY-G.sanction_protocol: SECC/Awaas+ list -> sanction -> instalment on photo-verified stage (AwaasSoft/AwaasApp) -> UC -> CAG

PMAY-U.const_basis: Urban poverty alleviation & housing — Twelfth Schedule (74th Amendment); CSS implemented through ULBs.
PMAY-U.implementing_tier: Urban Local Body (Municipal Corporation), State Level Nodal Agency
PMAY-U.funding_pattern: Central assistance per vertical (e.g. ₹1.5 lakh/unit BLC); rest State/ULB/beneficiary
PMAY-U.fiscal_route: Union MoHUA -> State Level Nodal Agency -> ULB -> beneficiary (PFMS)
PMAY-U.sanction_protocol: DPR -> CSMC approval -> central assistance in instalments -> geo-tagged -> UC -> CAG

AMRUT.full_name: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation & Urban Transformation
AMRUT.const_basis: Water supply, sewerage, urban amenities — Twelfth Schedule (74th Amendment); CSS to ULBs.
AMRUT.implementing_tier: Urban Local Body, State High Powered Steering Committee
AMRUT.funding_pattern: Central share by city size: 1/3 for >10 lakh pop, 1/2 for <10 lakh; rest State+ULB
AMRUT.fiscal_route: Union MoHUA -> State -> ULB; State Annual Action Plan basis

NMCG.full_name: National Mission for Clean Ganga (Namami Gange)
NMCG.const_basis: Inter-state rivers & river valleys (Union List Entry 56) where Parliament declares Union control; Ganga basin notified.
NMCG.implementing_tier: NMCG (registered society) -> State Programme Mgmt Groups -> ULB/agency
NMCG.funding_pattern: 100% central (flagship period); hybrid-annuity PPP for STPs
NMCG.fiscal_route: Union -> Clean Ganga Fund / NMCG -> SPMG -> executing agency
NMCG.sanction_protocol: DPR -> Executive Committee sanction -> milestone release -> third-party + CAG audit

NSAP.const_basis: Social security & social insurance (Concurrent List Entry 23); Directive Principle Art. 41 obligation.
NSAP.implementing_tier: State Social Welfare dept -> District -> Block; DBT pensions
NSAP.funding_pattern: Central pension component + State top-up (varies by state)
NSAP.fiscal_route: Union MoRD -> State -> DBT to beneficiary (old-age/widow/disability pension)
NSAP.sanction_protocol: Beneficiary list -> sanction -> DBT -> UC -> CAG

DAY-NULM.full_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana — National Urban Livelihoods Mission
DAY-NULM.const_basis: Urban poverty alleviation — Twelfth Schedule (74th Amendment).
DAY-NULM.implementing_tier: State Urban Livelihoods Mission -> City Mission Mgmt Unit (ULB)
DAY-NULM.sanction_protocol: City plan -> sanction -> instalment on progress -> UC -> CAG

15th FC Health Grants.full_name: Fifteenth Finance Commission — Health Grants to Local Bodies
15th FC Health Grants.const_basis: Finance Commission grants under Art. 280; health is Concurrent (Entry 23A etc.). Grants-in-aid under Art. 275.
15th FC Health Grants.ministry: Ministry of Finance / 15th Finance Commission award (Union)
15th FC Health Grants.implementing_tier: Local bodies (PRI/ULB) via State; tied health grants
15th FC Health Grants.funding_pattern: 100% Union grant (FC award), tied to health-infrastructure outcomes
15th FC Health Grants.fiscal_route: Union -> State -> Local body (tied grant per 15th FC recommendation accepted by GoI)

MPLADS.full_name: Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme
MPLADS.const_basis: Central-sector scheme funded 100% by Union; MP recommends, District Authority executes.
MPLADS.implementing_tier: District Authority (DM/Collector) executes; MP only RECOMMENDS
MPLADS.funding_pattern: 100% Union; ₹5 cr / MP / year (released in two ₹2.5 cr instalments)
MPLADS.fiscal_route: Union MoSPI -> District Authority of MP's nodal district -> implementing agency
MPLADS.sanction_protocol: MP recommendation -> DM eligibility check -> sanction -> 2nd instalment only on >=80% UC + audit of 1st -> CAG

_ULB_CIVIC_BUDGET.const_basis: Eighteen functions devolved to municipalities — Twelfth Schedule (74th Constitutional Amendment, 1992), Art. 243W.
_ULB_CIVIC_BUDGET.ministry: State Urban Development dept (ULBs are creatures of State law)
_ULB_CIVIC_BUDGET.implementing_tier: Municipal Corporation (Commissioner = exec, Mayor = elected head)
_ULB_CIVIC_BUDGET.funding_pattern: Own-source revenue (property tax, fees) + Central+State grants-in-aid (often >50% grant-dependent)
_ULB_CIVIC_BUDGET.fiscal_route: Own revenue + (Union FC grants + State grants) -> Corporation consolidated fund -> departments
_ULB_CIVIC_BUDGET.sanction_protocol: Corporation budget passed by elected body -> dept spend -> State AG / Local Fund Audit -> CAG (technical guidance & supervision)

SWM Rules 2016.const_basis: Sanitation/SWM — Twelfth Schedule; rules under Environment (Protection) Act 1986 (Concurrent — environment, Entry 17A/17B).
SWM Rules 2016.ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change (Union) — rules; ULB implements
SWM Rules 2016.funding_pattern: ULB own + grants (no dedicated central transfer line; statutory obligation)
SWM Rules 2016.fiscal_route: Regulatory mandate; funded from ULB budget + AMRUT/SBM convergence
SWM Rules 2016.sanction_protocol: Statutory compliance -> State Pollution Control Board oversight -> NGT/CAG

_meta.protocol_render_note: Panel render hook: in renderDistrictPanel, for each department.schemes[] and ledger[].scheme, look up _meta.scheme_registry (resolving via _meta.scheme_aliases) to badge it with its constitutional list (union/state/concurrent/local_body), ministry, and funding pattern. For each roster role, look up _meta.authority_map to badge who APPOINTS that post (Union/State/elected) — surfacing the dual-control tension. _meta.protocol_layers holds the four-layer explainer for a 'How the system works' section. This layer is STRUCTURAL (authority/route), carries no money figures, so it does not touch the PDF-cited figure-gap rules.

system_notes.note: Kolkata has no conventional District Magistrate/Collector. Magisterial powers vest in the Commissioner of Police (one of the oldest such posts in British India); a limited Collector post handles stamp revenue/registration; service delivery is run by the Kolkata Municipal Corporation. A standard 'who is the DM responsible for this money' question therefore has no single answer here.

MPLADS delivery in Kolkata's metro seats is recommendation-heavy but completion-poor: Kolkata Uttar completed 3 of 36 works, Kolkata Dakshin 0 of 73 (as on 2026-01-06). A WB-wide review found dense metropolitan seats show limited tangible outcomes versus rural constituencies — money flows in on paper but converts to far less on the ground.

Fiscal dependence: ~52% of Kolkata Municipal Corporation's ₹5,525 cr receipts (BE 2025-26) is Government Grant-in-Aid from Central + State governments (₹2,897 cr), versus ₹2,628 cr raised from its own sources. More than half of the city's civic money is transferred down rather than locally generated — and the budget still runs a deficit (expenditure ₹5,639.56 cr).

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

cases.order_ref: NGT Eastern Zone, 25 Oct 2017 — 'Temple of Knowledge'
cases.detail: NGT ordered demolition of a 60-ft illegal structure built by filling wetland (Vedic Dharma Sansthan Trust); EKWMA directed to demolish. Petition by PUBLIC (2016). Post-2006-Act filling held wholly illegal.

cases.order_ref: NGT EZ, Ranjit Kumar Sapui v. State of WB (2023–)
cases.detail: NGT directed EKWMA to clear illegal structures/godowns and restore filled land to water body; reports of ~88.5 acres illegally filled (Nazirabad).

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.subject: East Kolkata Wetlands (Ramsar site, 12,500 ha) — India's largest natural sewage-treatment + fishery belt, shrinking under real-estate encroachment as the city expands east
timeline.range_note: Estimates vary by boundary: ~65 km²→~41 km² (~36% loss, 1991–2021, The Wire/Wikipedia) up to 91.2 km²→33.4 km² (~63% loss, 1991–2025, Landsat/ML study). Direction is unambiguous; the exact ha depends on the boundary drawn.

points.note: ≈65 km² extent (The Wire / Wikipedia, ~36%-loss series baseline)
≈41 km² — ~36% loss over 30 yrs; driver = illegal land conversion for real estate as Kolkata expanded east

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.pattern: Bowl-shaped, near-sea-level city drains only by pumping; heavy monsoon spells + high tide waterlog the same low pockets each year (the East Kolkata Wetlands were the natural monsoon sink).
monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Ganga (Hooghly), Teesta, Damodar — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

system_notes.note: MGNREGS — the rural job-guarantee scheme — was FROZEN for West Bengal (and thus Birbhum) for nearly four years. The Centre stopped fund release from 9 March 2022 under Section 27 of the MGNREGA Act, citing non-compliance/corruption. Work resumed only 1 June 2026 after Supreme Court intervention. This is the opposite dysfunction to Kolkata's: not 'money came and wasn't spent', but money WITHHELD from the top — wages went unpaid for months.

Pending MGNREGS dues to West Bengal stood at ₹3,038 cr (Centre's figure, 2025 Rajya Sabha) — the highest of any state; the state claims ₹18,000 cr across MGNREGS+PMAY-G. A standard rural district like Birbhum, MGNREGS-dependent, bore the brunt: assets unbuilt, migrants displaced.

Delivery contrast: Bolpur (the Birbhum-area Lok Sabha seat) is West Bengal's TOP MPLADS performer — MP Asit Kumar Mal recommended 189 works, completed 67, and spent ₹14.27 cr (highest of all 42 WB MPs), versus Kolkata's metro seats completing 3/36 and 0/73. Rural delivery outpaced the metros.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Ganga (Hooghly), Teesta, Damodar — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. Crossed by Ganga (Hooghly), Teesta, Damodar — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Ganga (Hooghly), Teesta, Damodar — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Ganga (Hooghly), Teesta, Damodar — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Ganga (Hooghly), Teesta, Damodar — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

system_notes.note: Jamshedpur is the only major city in India with NO democratically elected municipality. It was run as a private Tata township via the Jamshedpur Notified Area Committee (JNAC), services delivered by JUSCO (a Tata Steel subsidiary). A 1993 constitutional provision for an 'industrial township' (Art. 243Q proviso) let it avoid a municipal corporation despite the 74th Amendment. So 'who is responsible for civic money' has never had a normal municipal answer here.

In 2025 the Jharkhand govt dissolved JNAC and formed the Jamshedpur Industrial Area Committee — a NOMINATED (not elected) body of 27: 6 state govt, 11 Tata Steel, 10 local. The East Singhbhum Deputy Commissioner is vice-chairperson; the district-in-charge minister chairs. MLA Saryu Roy called it unconstitutional for sidestepping the 74th Amendment's elected-local-body mandate. Tata holds the largest single bloc on the body governing the city.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Subarnarekha, Damodar, Koel — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Subarnarekha, Damodar, Koel — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Island territory: CRZ + fragile ecology tightly cap construction; everything imported; tsunami/cyclone exposure. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: Operational airport + class from AAI/DGCA public record. Annual passenger traffic is a gap until a public AAI figure is pinned — not fabricated.

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Penna — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices

Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Penna — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Penna — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

authority.accountable_to: State Govt (posted by State) on State subjects; IAS is an All-India Service controlled jointly
authority.const_basis: All-India Services (Art. 312): recruited by Union (UPSC), serve the State; dual control.

authority.appointed_by: Union (IPS cadre) posted by State
authority.accountable_to: State Govt; State Home dept / DGP chain
authority.const_basis: Police is a State subject (State List Entry 2); officers are IPS (All-India Service).

authority.accountable_to: High Court (judicial side); separation of powers

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Penna — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Penna — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Hilly, high-rainfall Northeast: landslides, riverine flooding, and remoteness raise the cost and slow the pace of development. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Brahmaputra, Siang, Lohit — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.
