language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Mahanadi, Indravati, Sone — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: District RTO code(s) + office (state transport dept / MoRTH). Registered-vehicle count is a gap unless a public Vahan figure is pinned — not fabricated.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: Operational airport + class from AAI/DGCA public record. Annual passenger traffic is a gap until a public AAI figure is pinned — not fabricated.

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: Tracked by an official house-price index (NHB RESIDEX). The index VALUE is a gap here — pin a quoted RBI/NHB figure; not fabricated. Coverage is city-level.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Daman Ganga — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

politics.note: State government snapshot; verify against ECI — governments change. Alignment is shown to juxtapose with money flow, NOT as a causal/bias claim.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

cases.order_ref: NGT O.A. 537/2023; DDA action plan; ≥15 demolition drives
cases.detail: NGT directed DDA to remove floodplain encroachments and restore the O-zone after the July-2023 flood; DDA issued eviction notices (e.g. 310 families, Yamuna Bazar) and began wetland restoration (Asita, Yamuna Vanasthali) — rehabilitation criticised as partial.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.subject: Yamuna floodplain (the protected 'O-zone') ~75% encroached by roads, colonies and casting yards — exposed by the July-2023 flood
timeline.range_note: ~75% of Delhi's floodplain reportedly encroached; NGT: ~230k O-zone households not on a sewer; DDA has run ≥15 demolition drives since the mid-2000s under NGT/court orders.

points.note: July 2023 Yamuna flood — floodplain encroachment + siltation + barrage operation amplified it; forced a DDA master-plan rethink (NGT O.A. 537/2023)

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.old_course: The Yamuna has migrated east over centuries (old courses under the walled city / ISBT); the Sahibi palaeochannel enters via the Najafgarh drain. Colonies on the old floodplain flood when the river reclaims it.
paleochannel.why_it_floods: July-2023 flood inundated areas built on the historic floodplain / Zone-O the river naturally occupies.
paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.basis: DDA's Master Plan designates the active Yamuna floodplain as Zone-O where permanent construction is barred; NGT repeatedly ordered its restoration and eviction of floodplain colonies after the 2023 flood.
unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.delineation: DDA Zone-O boundary + NGT-directed active-floodplain line
encroachment_zone.status: officially delineated (Zone-O); encroachment mapped by DDA post-2023
encroachment_zone.note: The no-development zone is defined in the Master Plan and NGT orders; an open machine-readable polygon of the encroached extent isn't published — boundary known, geometry a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. Crossed by Yamuna — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

cases.order_ref: PIL/NGT critique of riverfront model (Paryavaran Suraksha Samiti)
cases.detail: Sabarmati Riverfront reclaimed floodplain and channelised the river; critics (who took Gujarat civic bodies to NGT) link narrowing + blocked drains + lost lakes (~2.2% blue cover) to worsening urban flooding; lower promenade submerged 2025.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.subject: Sabarmati floodplain reclaimed + lakes lost — the riverfront narrowed the channel; the lower promenade itself floods each monsoon
timeline.range_note: Ahmedabad's 'blue' (water-body) cover down to ~2.2% of area; Sabarmati riverfront reclaimed floodplain and channelised the river; Vasna barrage opened (27 gates, >1.2 lakh cusecs) submerged the riverfront in 2025.

points.note: Sabarmati Riverfront construction began — embankments + floodplain reclamation
riverfront lower promenade submerged; blocked drains + lost lakes (~2.2% blue cover) worsen urban flooding

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Narmada, Tapi, Sabarmati and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Narmada, Tapi, Sabarmati and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Narmada, Tapi, Sabarmati and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

system_notes.note: Surat is the world's diamond-cutting capital — ~90% of the world's natural diamonds and ~25% of lab-grown diamonds are polished here, across ~6,000 units (70% MSMEs). timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Narmada, Tapi, Sabarmati and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

cases.detail: A Gurugram admin study to the NGT found 389 water bodies lost since 1956 (640→251); Ghata lake shrank ~370 ac → ~2 ac; Basai wetland ~25% of original by 2022; Badshahpur storm-drain encroached. INTACH moved the SC (Jul 2023) over the Najafgarh embankment; matter before the NGT.

timeline.subject: Gurugram's vanished lakes & drains — 389 water bodies lost since 1956; Ghata lake 370 ac → ~2 ac; the natural drainage that never flooded now floods every monsoon
timeline.range_note: Admin study to NGT: 640 water bodies (1956) → 251 today (389 lost). Ghata lake ~370 ac (to early 2000s) → ~2 ac; Basai wetland ~25% of original by 2022; Badshahpur storm-drain encroached. No floods reported till 1998; 'Gurujam' from 2016.

paleochannel.old_course: The Sahibi (Rajasthan→Delhi) once fed the Najafgarh jheel, a large seasonal lake straddling SW Delhi–Gurugram; its bed and the Badshahpur drain are the natural low line the monsoon still runs down. Gurugram's sectors sit across this palaeo-drainage.
paleochannel.why_it_floods: Built-up sectors + choked Badshahpur drain block the Sahibi/Najafgarh natural line → the old lakebed re-floods (2016 'Gurujam', recurrent waterlogging).

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. Crossed by Yamuna, Ghaggar — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. Crossed by Yamuna, Ghaggar — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Steep Himalayan terrain: high per-km infrastructure cost, landslide + glacial-lake-outburst-flood (GLOF) exposure, seismic zone. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Sutlej, Beas, Ravi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Steep Himalayan terrain: high per-km infrastructure cost, landslide + glacial-lake-outburst-flood (GLOF) exposure, seismic zone. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Sutlej, Beas, Ravi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Steep Himalayan terrain: high per-km infrastructure cost, landslide + glacial-lake-outburst-flood (GLOF) exposure, seismic zone. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Sutlej, Beas, Ravi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Steep Himalayan terrain: high per-km infrastructure cost, landslide + glacial-lake-outburst-flood (GLOF) exposure, seismic zone. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Jhelum, Chenab, Indus — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Steep Himalayan terrain: high per-km infrastructure cost, landslide + glacial-lake-outburst-flood (GLOF) exposure, seismic zone. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Jhelum, Chenab, Indus — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Steep Himalayan terrain: high per-km infrastructure cost, landslide + glacial-lake-outburst-flood (GLOF) exposure, seismic zone. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Jhelum, Chenab, Indus — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

system_notes.note: Bengaluru's civic body BBMP runs a ₹19,931 cr budget (2025-26) — second only to Mumbai's BMC among Indian municipalities, and larger than several state budgets. Own-source revenue ₹11,149 cr (property tax target ₹5,716 cr) funds 56% of it; the rest is Central+State grants-in-aid.

Governance deficit: the ₹19,931 cr budget was presented by a state-appointed Special Commissioner, not an elected council — the FIFTH consecutive budget without an elected body (BBMP's term lapsed in 2020). In 2025 BBMP was being restructured under the Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA), splitting the metro into multiple city corporations. A democratic deficit in India's tech capital.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Krishna, Kaveri, Tungabhadra and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Krishna, Kaveri, Tungabhadra and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.
