flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Krishna, Kaveri, Tungabhadra and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Krishna, Kaveri, Tungabhadra and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Krishna, Kaveri, Tungabhadra and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Periyar, Bharathapuzha, Pamba — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

system_notes.note: Kochi Municipal Corporation is ~50% grant-dependent: of ₹453 cr total revenue (audited FY24), ₹225 cr is government grant vs ₹229 cr own-source — and it runs close to balance (expenditure ₹402 cr). Comparable to Kolkata's grant-dependence but with a far healthier own-source share (₹229 cr own vs ₹184 cr tax). A relatively well-run urban local body.

Ernakulam is Kerala's commercial capital (Kochi) — port, IT (Infopark/SmartCity), shipbuilding (Cochin Shipyard, a central PSU), and the Cochin International Airport (CIAL), the world's first fully solar-powered airport and a pioneering public-private-shareholder model. Diversified base, unlike single-industry districts.

plants.name: Cochin Shipyard Ltd (CSL)
plants.capacity: India's largest shipbuilding & maintenance facility; built INS Vikrant (1st indigenous aircraft carrier)
plants.significance: Strategic defence + commercial shipbuilding; delivered India's first indigenous aircraft carrier.
plants.heritage_note: Incorporated 29 Apr 1972 as a GoI company; first phase 1982; built INS Vikrant.
plants.lineage: GoI company (1972) under Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways; listed PSU (IPO 2017)

plants.name: BPCL Kochi Refinery
plants.capacity: ~15.5 MMTPA — among India's largest public-sector refineries
plants.significance: One of India's biggest refineries; anchors Kochi's petrochemical cluster.
plants.heritage_note: Inaugurated 23 Sep 1966 (as Cochin Refineries, Phillips Petroleum JV); now BPCL.
plants.lineage: Cochin Refineries (US JV, 1966) → nationalised → Kochi Refineries → merged into BPCL (central PSU)

plants.name: Cochin International Airport (CIAL)
plants.capacity: World's first fully solar-powered airport
plants.significance: First Indian airport built on a public-private-shareholder model (1999); a much-cited governance innovation.
plants.heritage_note: First Indian airport on a public-private-shareholder model; world's first fully solar-powered airport.
plants.lineage: CIAL — first PPP airport in India; Kerala govt + NRIs/public as shareholders (1999)

Ernakulam.plants_note: Ernakulam/Kochi has a DIVERSIFIED base — central PSUs (Cochin Shipyard, BPCL refinery), IT parks, port, and the CIAL public-shareholder airport. rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Periyar, Bharathapuzha, Pamba — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Periyar, Bharathapuzha, Pamba — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

authority.appointed_by: Union (IAS cadre, allotted to State by Centre)
authority.accountable_to: State Govt (posted by State) on State subjects; IAS is an All-India Service controlled jointly
authority.const_basis: All-India Services (Art. 312): recruited by Union (UPSC), serve the State; dual control.

authority.appointed_by: Union (IPS cadre) posted by State
authority.accountable_to: State Govt; State Home dept / DGP chain
authority.const_basis: Police is a State subject (State List Entry 2); officers are IPS (All-India Service).

authority.appointed_by: Governor in consultation with the High Court (Art. 233)
authority.accountable_to: High Court (judicial side); separation of powers
authority.const_basis: Art. 233–235: District Judges appointed by Governor on HC consultation; HC controls subordinate judiciary.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Narmada, Chambal, Betwa and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

Chhatarpur.applicable_schemes_note: Structural: these central schemes reach every district of this type. Amounts are intentionally null until a government PDF is cited (project rule: PDF-cited or it's a gap).

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Narmada, Chambal, Betwa and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

authority.appointed_by: Union (IAS cadre, allotted to State by Centre)
authority.accountable_to: State Govt (posted by State) on State subjects; IAS is an All-India Service controlled jointly
authority.const_basis: All-India Services (Art. 312): recruited by Union (UPSC), serve the State; dual control.

authority.appointed_by: Union (IPS cadre) posted by State
authority.accountable_to: State Govt; State Home dept / DGP chain
authority.const_basis: Police is a State subject (State List Entry 2); officers are IPS (All-India Service).

authority.accountable_to: High Court (judicial side); separation of powers
authority.const_basis: Art. 233–235: District Judges appointed by Governor on HC consultation; HC controls subordinate judiciary.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Narmada, Chambal, Betwa and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

authority.accountable_to: State Govt (posted by State) on State subjects; IAS is an All-India Service controlled jointly
authority.const_basis: All-India Services (Art. 312): recruited by Union (UPSC), serve the State; dual control.

authority.const_basis: Police is a State subject (State List Entry 2); officers are IPS (All-India Service).

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Narmada, Chambal, Betwa and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Narmada, Chambal, Betwa and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Narmada, Chambal, Betwa and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Narmada, Chambal, Betwa and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Narmada, Chambal, Betwa and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Tapi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

system_notes.note: BMC (Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation) is India's richest civic body. Its 2025-26 budget of ₹74,427 cr is the largest in its history — bigger than the annual budget of several Indian STATES, and ~25× Kolkata's KMC. Over a decade BMC allocated ₹2.19 lakh cr. The 'money flowing through one district' here dwarfs most state-level flows.

Like Kolkata, Mumbai's civic governance has run WITHOUT an elected body since March 2022 — the ₹74,427 cr budget was presented to a state-appointed administrator (BMC Commissioner Bhushan Gagrani), not an elected council. Elections were finally held in Jan 2026. A democratic-deficit dysfunction in the country's richest municipality.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Tapi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Tapi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).
