language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Tapi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Tapi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Hilly, high-rainfall Northeast: landslides, riverine flooding, and remoteness raise the cost and slow the pace of development. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Barak, Imphal — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Hilly, high-rainfall Northeast: landslides, riverine flooding, and remoteness raise the cost and slow the pace of development. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Barak, Imphal — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: Operational airport + class from AAI/DGCA public record. Annual passenger traffic is a gap until a public AAI figure is pinned — not fabricated.

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices

politics.note: State government snapshot; verify against ECI — governments change. Alignment is shown to juxtapose with money flow, NOT as a causal/bias claim.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Hilly, high-rainfall Northeast: landslides, riverine flooding, and remoteness raise the cost and slow the pace of development. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Brahmaputra tributaries, Barak — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Hilly, high-rainfall Northeast: landslides, riverine flooding, and remoteness raise the cost and slow the pace of development. Crossed by Tlawng, Barak — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Hilly, high-rainfall Northeast: landslides, riverine flooding, and remoteness raise the cost and slow the pace of development. Crossed by Tlawng, Barak — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Hilly, high-rainfall Northeast: landslides, riverine flooding, and remoteness raise the cost and slow the pace of development. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Mahanadi, Brahmani, Baitarani — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Mahanadi, Brahmani, Baitarani — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Mahanadi, Brahmani, Baitarani — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Mahanadi, Brahmani, Baitarani — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

authority.const_basis: All-India Services (Art. 312): recruited by Union (UPSC), serve the State; dual control.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Mahanadi, Brahmani, Baitarani — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Mahanadi, Brahmani, Baitarani — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

applicable_schemes.note: Scheme applies to this district by programme design; district-level amount & utilisation are not sourced (no PDF) — figure_gap.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Sutlej, Beas, Ravi — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

authority.appointed_by: Union (IAS cadre, allotted to State by Centre)
authority.accountable_to: State Govt (posted by State) on State subjects; IAS is an All-India Service controlled jointly
authority.const_basis: All-India Services (Art. 312): recruited by Union (UPSC), serve the State; dual control.

authority.appointed_by: Union (IPS cadre) posted by State
authority.accountable_to: State Govt; State Home dept / DGP chain
authority.const_basis: Police is a State subject (State List Entry 2); officers are IPS (All-India Service).

authority.appointed_by: Governor in consultation with the High Court (Art. 233)
authority.accountable_to: High Court (judicial side); separation of powers
authority.const_basis: Art. 233–235: District Judges appointed by Governor on HC consultation; HC controls subordinate judiciary.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Sutlej, Beas, Ravi — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Sutlej, Beas, Ravi — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

paleochannel.note: The river's natural course over centuries/millennia — floods reclaim the old bed. Pinned from ISRO/Bhuvan palaeochannel + CGWB/GSI + press; the exact channel polygon stays a gap.

unsafe_zone.note: OFFICIAL 'do-not-build' zones — CRZ no-development, CWC/NDMA flood-hazard, no-development O-zones, gov-declared unsafe/sinking areas. Stronger than the derived <100 m proxy; per-district CZMP category stays a gap.

monsoon_inundation.note: Seasonal (monsoon) inundation from ISRO-Bhuvan flood-extent mapping + IMD monsoon data — the recurring pattern behind the live rain radar. Precise seasonal area (ha) stays a gap.

encroachment_zone.note: The encroached ZONE (floodplain/water-body/CRZ/FTL line), not just the NGT case. Pinned where an authority published the boundary; the open GIS polygon itself is a gap.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Arid/semi-arid: water scarcity is the binding constraint; flash floods in cloudbursts despite low annual rainfall. Crossed by Chambal, Banas, Luni and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_exposure.note: Share of district area below 5 m / 10 m elevation + raster elevation stats from open AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM-derived, z9 ≈ 300 m/px), polygon-masked; pixels below -3 m treated as ocean/void and excluded. A within-district raster upgrade of the centroid elevation. Exposure proxy (area below a contour), NOT a hydrological flood model.

health.note: State-level NFHS-5 shown; per-district figures are a gap (district NFHS fact-sheet PDFs).

economy.as_of: RBI Handbook (per-capita NSDP, current prices, recent year)
economy.note: State per-capita NSDP shown; per-district income is a gap (no official district series).

vehicles.as_of: MoRTH Vahan / state transport dept (RTO codes stable; counts as-published)
vehicles.note: State number-plate prefix shown (every plate in the state starts with it); the specific district RTO code + office is a gap here.

aviation.as_of: AAI / DGCA public record (airport class stable; traffic as-published)
aviation.note: No operational airport in this district per AAI/DGCA. (A false is asserted here, not an unknown — the nearest airport is in another district.)

housing.as_of: RBI HPI (10 cities) / NHB RESIDEX (~50 cities) — coverage, not per-district prices
housing.note: No official house-price index (RBI HPI / NHB RESIDEX) covers this district — asserted, not a gap. This is WHY a per-district 'housing bubble' can't be measured from official data for most of India.
